title: Mixed Event — Imprisoned Marionette — Episode5 Too Similar

meta.Event Outline: To fulfill her promise to Mafuyu, Kanade wants to learn more about her. Meanwhile, the group visits a doll exhibit, where Mafuyu has a strange experience.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, you're really pale!
What happened? You're not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You mean this marionette here?
What's wrong with it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There you are!
Whoa! What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mafuyu! You okay?!
Are you feeling sick?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, good. Looks like you're better now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't scare us like that.
You had us worried there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, did that doll make you feel something?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why did that doll make you feel sick?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I only know that I felt sick...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade, not sure why you're bringing this up now, but maybe we should talk about it at another time since Mafuyu's not feeling too good?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm so close to understanding what could have left Mafuyu so shaken.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe you should go home first and rest a little. I'll walk you to the station, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's fine. I can go home by myself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I understood nothing in the end, even though Mafuyu definitely felt something strongly back there.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What did she see in that doll?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know... I just don't know right now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I may not know, but maybe...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I wonder where she is today.
I hope I can find her quickly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Miku!
I'm glad I found you so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mizuki taught me, in case I feel bored when I'm here by myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, I wanted to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. They may be the key to writing a song that will save her if I can just find out what they are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've been trying to talk with her about a lot of things to get to know her better, but I still don't understand.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought maybe you knew something since you were with her back then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I don't know what Mafuyu is feeling right now either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born from her feelings, but it doesn't mean I know what she's feeling right now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But we can think about it together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was so close to understanding something at the doll exhibit today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. When Mafuyu saw a certain doll there, she had this look of tremendous disgust on her face.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So I think she must have felt something back then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What sort of doll was it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A beautiful doll in a dress. It was seated on a pedestal that looked like a golden cage and... Oh yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think it was a marionette.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe the doll reminded Mafuyu of herself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's just a feeling that I have...
